instruction: Create a WAV file named 'Baby Justin Bieber.wav' on the desktop by converting the audio track from the video file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting audio from video and converting to WAV format using VLC. Evaluator checks: (1) File exists on Desktop (35%), (2) Correct filename 'Baby Justin Bieber.wav' (25%), (3) File is WAV format via MIME type (audio/x-wav or audio/wav) (25%), (4) File size is reasonable (>100KB, 15%). WAV format verification ensures proper conversion, not just renaming.
metadata.verification: Verified by checking file existence, correct filename, WAV MIME type (audio/x-wav or audio/wav), and minimum size of 100KB to ensure successful audio extraction and format conversion.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: File exists (35%) + Correct filename (25%) + Is WAV format (25%) + Adequate size (15%) = 100%

Complete coverage: checks Desktop location via path, exact filename match, actual WAV format conversion, and non-empty audio content
